data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to redirect users to app stores for updates and reviews on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows apps to programmatically open the app store detail page, review list, or write-review page. On Android, it automatically detects installed vendor app markets or falls back to the generic market protocol.
use_when: You want to prompt users to update your app via the store.
You need to direct users to the app review or feedback page.
avoid_when: You need in-app downloading and installation of APK files directly from your server.
Targeting Android devices with a minSdk below 24 or iOS below 15.0.
strengths: Automatic vendor app market detection on Android (Huawei, Honor, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, Meizu, Samsung).
Pre-launch capability checks to verify the link can be handled before attempting a jump.
weaknesses: Review list page is not supported on Android and throws an UnsupportedError.
Review deep links on Android are restricted to specific vendor markets (OPPO, vivo, Honor).
data.setup_notes: Requires SDK 3.11.0+, Flutter 3.41.0+, Android minSdk 24, and iOS deployment target 15.0.

alternatives.name: url_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer manually crafting store URLs using url_launcher instead of using a dedicated helper package.
